selection_rule: Precommitted P11 public task selection: next four previously unexposed train scenarios in sorted ID order, variant _1; never replace based on outcomes.
server_lease_basis: Identical server command restarted after P10 complete and empty model slot; bounded --max-seconds14400. Per-trial evaluation180sec plus180sec reserve, no start below8100sec remaining.
scope: Ordinary incremental ledger baseline, same four development tasks. Not a new method or reproduction of a claimed paper score.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: Same task, model, public API discovery, executor prompt and budgets as P11/P12/P13.
Reuse the P6 ledger prompt and item schema; standard native conversation and currently exposed public API schemas supplied as inert data. Only submit_ledger is callable.
At most one ledger generation before each agent call when the 4096-token history proxy is exceeded. Ledger and memory note count toward this proxy.
After valid update retain the most recent two spans, extended to original whole-turn closure, and the new ledger. Previous cited IDs remain valid provenance but are not automatically read again.
Invalid ledger retains prior ledger and all currently visible raw turns. Source validation is syntactic, not semantic proof.
All generation, invalid output, count attempts, retries as explicit agent actions and stops count. No environment operation by the ledger role.
No outcome-based task replacement, hidden target list, or manual correction of generated ledger.
history_representation: Original native turns stay archived. Incremental ledger tracks observed targets, conditions and progress; recent original turns and fallible ledger are given to executor. read_span stays available.
